content.summary: Accepted within the copyediting and bounded text-reuse remit after rereading the final prose and repaired formulas. The manuscript matches the exact bytes audited in round nine; terminology repairs remain intact and no required revision remains. Acceptance does not certify comprehensive originality, mathematical priority, independent reproduction, or human review.

checks.method: Recomputed snapshot/manuscript hashes and verified F38 classification-to-computation, computation-to-script, manuscript, and source-excerpt hash bindings.
checks.observation: All bindings match. F38 records three occurrences of one attributed nine-token title under the eight-token threshold method. Corpus remains F16/F17 excerpts only; no human review or semantic-paraphrase analysis occurred.

checks.method: Reread final prose and four repaired inline expressions; compared external-result attribution with F17 lines 984 and 1187.
checks.observation: The manuscript credits enumeration-based I(27), distinguishes external computational verification from Lean coverage, and leaves local exclusion outstanding. Code delimiters preserve the four multiplication expressions; D4 remains distinct from the degree cap.
